mapper.select: select A.slug articleSlug, A.view_count articleViewCount, A.created_at articleCreatedAt, (select count(1) from article_favorites AF where AF.article_id = A.id) articleFavoritesCount, (select count(1) from comments C where C.article_id = A.id) articleCommentsCount from articles A where A.slug = #{slug}

select A.slug articleSlug, A.title articleTitle, A.description articleDescription, count(AF.user_id) articleFavoritesCount from article_favorites AF join articles A on A.id = AF.article_id where AF.created_at >= #{since} group by A.id, A.slug, A.title, A.description order by articleFavoritesCount desc, max(AF.created_at) desc limit #{limit}
